_comment: Per-NPC dialogue voice, keyed by NPC display name (case-insensitive, EXACT match on the FULL name). 'voices' = pitch (men deeper <1.0, women higher >1.0, all distinct; ~0.5 = floor/very grave, ~1.0 = neutral, ~1.4 = very high; the markup {pitch=X} multiplies this). 'sounds' = optional per-NPC blip sound id (any sound event id; else the client's global blip preset). WARNING: the key is the FULL CustomName lowercased, e.g. 'flugel the traveler' (not 'flugel').
